scope: Transferable Claude interaction principles for MX-01 Direction 2

claims.claim: Claude Research exposes easy-to-check or inline citations for source verification.
claims.mx01_inference: Open exact candidate provenance adjacent to the decision.

claims.claim: Claude interactive connectors display tool UI inside the conversation so users can see what is happening; drafts can be reviewed before posting.
claims.mx01_inference: Keep preview, execution, reconciliation, and receipt in one continuous decision surface.

claims.claim: Claude memory and thinking-partner features are presented as carrying context through iterative work.
claims.mx01_inference: Expose a compact persistent progress map across action states.

claims.claim: Claude Design can inherit a real design system and supports targeted inline or direct edits.
claims.mx01_inference: Preserve the selected Talent Signal design and correct evidence/facts in place.

claims.claim: Claude Code artifacts update in place, derive from full session context, and retain version history.
claims.mx01_inference: Use one evolving Session with stable operation identity, readback, and reversible history.
